name: binary_search
summary: Halve a sorted range each step until the target is found.
vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21], run(a) { const target = 15; let lo = 0; let hi = a.length; while (lo < hi) { const mid = lo + Math.floor((hi - lo) / 2); a.cursor('lo', lo); a.cursor('hi', hi - 1); a.cursor('mid', mid); const v = a.probe(mid); if (v === target) { a.found(mid); return mid; } if (v < target) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid; } return -1; } })
